content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user","i_want":"to see all of my tasks in a report table with Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks metrics on the Task Reporting page","so_that":"I can see an aggregated overview of my tasks in one place","business_description":"The Task Reporting page presents an aggregated view of the user's tasks. It shows every task in a tabular display and shows the metrics Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks. The backend report endpoint supplies the task rows and the metric values. Filtering, searching and sorting are delivered by separate stories.","business_value":"Users can check the status of all their tasks at a glance without opening each task, which supports tracking progress.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"The user has 5 tasks, 2 with status Open and 3 with status Completed","when":"The user opens the Task Reporting page","then":"The table shows 5 rows, one per task, and the metrics show Total Tasks 5, Open Tasks 2 and Completed Tasks 3"},{"given":"The user has no tasks","when":"The user opens the Task Reporting page","then":"The table shows no task rows and the metrics show Total Tasks 0, Open Tasks 0 and Completed Tasks 0"},{"given":"The report endpoint returns tasks with their Title, Status, Priority and Due Date values","when":"The Task Reporting page loads","then":"Each table row shows the task Title, Status, Priority and Due Date from the endpoint response, with no values added or changed by the page"},{"given":"A user changes the status of a task from Open to Completed","when":"The user reloads the Task Reporting page","then":"The Open Tasks metric decreases by 1 and the Completed Tasks metric increases by 1, while Total Tasks stays the same"},{"given":"The report endpoint is called without any filter, search or sort parameters","when":"The request is processed","then":"The response contains all of the user's tasks and the three metric values Total, Open and Completed computed from those tasks"},{"given":"The report endpoint request fails with an error response","when":"The Task Reporting page loads","then":"The page shows an error message and does not show the table rows or the metric values as a successful result"}],"edge_cases":["The user has tasks with every Status value (Open, In Progress, Completed): the PRD does not say which status counts as Open or whether In Progress counts toward Open Tasks; this is an open question.","A task has no Due Date value: the PRD does not state how an empty Due Date is displayed; this is an open question.","The report endpoint fails: the page must not show a successful state (constraint).","Only tasks owned by the current user are included in the table and the metrics."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-change-task-status"],"definition_of_done":["GET report endpoint returns all of the user's tasks with Title, Status, Priority and Due Date","Endpoint response includes Total, Open and Completed counts computed from the same tasks","Endpoint returns an error response for internal or database failures, following the simple error handling approach","Task Reporting page renders one table row per task with values from the response","Task Reporting page shows Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks from the response","Page shows an error message and no success state when the request fails","Automated tests for the table and metrics pass"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"report-endpoint-with-metrics","title":"[BE] Add GET report endpoint with all tasks and Total, Open, Completed counts","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add a GET endpoint for the task report that returns all tasks of the current user with Title, Status, Priority and Due Date, plus the aggregated counts Total, Open and Completed. Without filter, search or sort parameters, the endpoint returns all tasks. Filtering, searching and sorting are out of scope for this task and belong to their own stories.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["GET endpoint returns all tasks of the current user","Response includes Total, Open and Completed counts computed from the returned tasks","Counts are zero when the user has no tasks","Error responses follow the simple error handling approach for internal and database errors","Endpoint has automated tests for normal and empty cases"]},{"key_slug":"task-report-page-table","title":"[FE] Build Task Reporting page with a table of all tasks","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Build the Task Reporting page that calls the report endpoint and shows every returned task as one row in a table with Title, Status, Priority and Due Date. The page does not change or add values to the response data.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d0e0fe7a","R-a1b267a3"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Page is reachable as Task Reporting","Table shows one row per task from the endpoint response","Table shows Title, Status, Priority and Due Date values unchanged","Page shows an error message and no success state when the request fails","Page does not apply optimistic updates"]},{"key_slug":"report-metric-cards","title":"[FE] Show Total, Open and Completed metrics on Task Reporting page","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Show the Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks metrics on the Task Reporting page, using the counts returned by the report endpoint.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-4ffbfafa"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Page shows Total Tasks, Open Tasks and Completed Tasks with the values from the endpoint","Metrics show 0 when the user has no tasks","Metrics are not shown as successful when the request fails"]},{"key_slug":"task-report-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for the task report table and metrics","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Write the automated test suite for the task report: endpoint behaviour, table rendering, metric values and the error case.","size":"S","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d0e0fe7a","R-a1b267a3","R-4ffbfafa","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover the 5-task and 0-task scenarios","Tests cover the Open to Completed status change reflected in metrics after reload","Tests cover endpoint failure and confirm no success state is shown","All tests pass in the CI pipeline"]}]}
